eps.d: In 1902, Adam Adamant is lured into a trap by his arch nemesis 'The Face' and frozen in ice for eternity. That is until he is accidentally freed by workmen in 1966. Bewildered to find himself in the Swinging Sixties, Adamant is taken in by mod girl and lifelong fan Georgina Jones. When Georgie's grandfather is killed by a couple of thugs, Adamant decides his services are once again needed.

Adamant rescues Georgie from two motorcyclists who were chasing her because of a stick of rock candy. Inside they find a incomprehensible diagram which leads them to Blackpool to investigate. When Punch and Judy man William E. Simms overhears the villains plotting to kill Adamant, he decides to intervene.
A highly placed intelligence officer has been Jeopardised by oriental blackmailers. Adamant is sent to Tokyo and finds a Giesha house where clients are regularly compromised by hidden cameras.
A blue carnation, the symbol of success for a high-pressure sales campaign, is also the symbol for something far more sinister.

eps.t: Allah is Not Always with You
eps.d: A dying girl gasping out the words: Vargos... Fluffy Club... Ahmed... leads Adam Adamant, gentleman adventurer, into the world of night-clubs, gambling, and murder.

The conveniently-timed deaths of a number of rich businessmen appear to have taken place shortly before they were due to receive large tax demands, arousing the suspicions of the Inland Revenue. The only common factor seems to have been their psychiatrist; Adam Adamant, posing as a harassed financier, makes an appointment with the man, who concludes from his patient's unusual mental history that…
The frantic world of high fashion and eccentric designers is a confusing one for Adam Adamant, but not for long when he finds it is also the setting for murder and espionage.
A pleasant weekend party becomes a nightmare for one man when he finds himself involved in a black magic ritual and a human sacrifice.
Georgina arrested for attempting to hold up a bank? Adam Adamant bailing her out? This is the odd beginning which leads them into the world of pop music - and a sinister plot.

BC equipment is being stolen and some newscasters are kidnapped, only to return speaking of the end of the world. Dr. Mort, whose profession is predicting the apocalypse, sets the date of his latest prophecy to September 30th.
Big business and high-priced escorts involve Adam Adamant in a wave of murders which shake the financial capitals of the world.
The world of beauty contestants and physical culture experts is the strange setting for a plot to destroy the human race.
A man is murdered in St. James's Park. This leads Adam to a strange club for women in Pall Mall and a committee of three old ladies called Faith, Hope, and Charity.
When Simms boards an underground train at Bank station, he unknowingly becomes involved in one of the most sinister conspiracies in British criminal history.
A dead mouse, a young boy, and a lonely mill lead Adam Adamant into a sinister web of evil that interrupts a quiet fishing holiday.
His old regiment plagued by mysterious deaths, Adamant is made C.O., when he discovers a plot to take over a nuclear missile installation.
A determined attempt to assassinate a visiting African leader causes a Government Minister to call on the services of Adam Adamant.
An oil tanker delivers its load to a country house and the driver gets a shock that turns his hair white.
Jankers Johnson, a wartime comrade of Simms, is mysteriously murdered at their old R.A.F. aerodrome: but before he dies he gets a message to Adam.
Adam gets on the wrong side of the ruler of an oil-rich country.
When a number of inventions are brought on to the market after the death of their inventors Adam Adamant is involved in a sinister plot.
Adam's old foe, The Face, has managed to survive from 1902 to the 60s and is just as determined to end Adam's life once and for all.
When Georgina goes to a party organised by the manufacturers of a new soft drink, she finds the drink is not as innocuous as it appears.
When Simms gets a message from Timothy Henshaw, an old friend from theatre days, both Simms and Adam find themselves mixed up in a curious affair at an old people's home.
The Face's new plans threaten to tear the world to pieces.
The Great Manton is killed while performing the bullet trick. Adam, using his powers of deduction, helps a reluctant policeman to find the murderer.
When a scientist destroys his invention for calming naturally fierce animals and then vanishes, Adam is involved in a sinister encounter with the agents of the Face.
When Simms's mother is charged with disturbing the peace Simms goes to help her and stumbles on to a sordid plot.
When a number of carefully planned robberies take place throughout the country and in such a way as to make it obvious that a master mind Is behind the operation, Adam becomes involved.
